objects.taxonomy_description: Elongated bicycle with two seats and two sets of pedals arranged in tandem (one behind the other). The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
